note: Sighted descent of the fast race-cue pilot (haltere.liftoff.fast_race_cue.SightedDescentConfig): while the checkpoint ring is clipped at the bottom edge of the image, the pilot never requests a flight path steeper than the ring's sighted line of sight. visual_brain --sighted-descent on|off|shadow (off by default; needs --descent-view; shadow computes and logs it and changes nothing). It lowers the view-keeping descent's sink bound (configs/pilot/descent_view.json version 3, unchanged), never below the in-view bound and never above the view rule's own bound: it only withholds sink that the pilot's own bottom-clip margin or the view rule's steep late would request. Generic and course-agnostic: the ring cue, the measured attitude and velocity and the camera calibration; no height above ground, no terrain memory, no course geometry, route, logged position or per-course value. The hash covers everything except frozen/frozen_at/sha256; a change needs a new version and a new freeze. Surrogate results, Straw-like scenarios and open-loop replays are development or held-out offline evidence, never flight evidence.

sighted_descent_notes.sighting: two fresh in-view ring-centre rays (marker u, v) with the marker at v >= edge_v (0.85: the lowest 15% of the image, about 8 degrees above the marker clamp line), captured at most agree_s (0.5 s) apart and agreeing within agree_deg (1.5 deg), set the line of sight to the later one's world depression; a single or disagreeing reading sets nothing
sighted_descent_notes.update: while the measured flight path is shallower than the line of sight it turns down at V sin(los - path)/growth_range_m (20 m): as fast as for a ring 20 m away; each bottom-clamped marker raises it to the clamped ray's depression
sighted_descent_notes.limit: while the ring is clipped at the bottom edge (pilot state below): the sink at which the flight path (measured horizontal speed, requested vertical speed) points margin_deg (1 deg) below the line of sight, at least the in-view bound at the current attitude (unfiltered), at most the view rule's bound
sighted_descent_notes.reset: an in-view cue above edge_v, a side or top clamp, a bottom-clamped marker whose u moves by more than switch_u (0.1), the pilot's checkpoint switch (new_target_deg), search and launch

Without growth the fast PD passed 2 more development checkpoints high (6 -> 8 on hill 8100-8111); the 30 m dead reckoning raised its high passes on the Straw variations 2 -> 6; growth 20 m kept every development high-pass count and gave the most contact reduction there.
